brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.requirement: Seven-cell honeycomb: a centre cell with six surrounding cells
requirements.evidence: Seven full hex bases (piece) at axial (0,0), (1,0), (1,-1), (0,-1), (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,1) on level 0, forming a flower.
Seven full top covers (cover, face top), one on each of the seven cells.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps (cap, face *) placed on the 18 outward-facing perimeter edges, three per outer cell; none of the six outer cells has an uncapped outside edge. check_build: meshClash clear, no rule errors.

finish.summary: Built a seven-cell hex work surface: seven full bases, a full top cover on each cell, and 18 caps on the perimeter edges. check_build reports meshClash clear and no errors. One warning remains: LOOSE_BODY, meaning the six outer bases could slide apart because no joint bolts were placed. The brief did not ask for joint bolts, so I left them out; adding them would lock the bases together.
